subtasks.title: Create per-subtask worktrees for multi-subtask parallel groups
subtasks.description: In runImplement's group loop, when a group has 2+ subtasks: (a) create a git worktree named <task-worktree>-st<subtask-id> from the task's feature branch, (b) patch .git file for container mode if applicable, (c) pass the new worktree path as cwd to createSession. For single-subtask groups: use pipeline.worktreePath directly (AC2).
acceptance_criteria: Multi-subtask groups (length >= 2): each subtask gets its own worktree at <task-worktree>-st<subtask-id>
Single-subtask groups: subtask uses pipeline.worktreePath directly
createSession receives the correct cwd (either per-subtask worktree or main worktree)
Container mode: per-subtask worktree .git files are patched via _patchWorktreeGitFile
Subtasks in a single-subtask group skip worktree isolation entirely (no overhead)

subtasks.title: Cherry-pick successful commits back to main worktree after group completes
subtasks.description: After Promise.allSettled completes for a multi-subtask group: (a) for each successful subtask, cherry-pick its commits onto the main task worktree in subtask-ID order using 'git cherry-pick' from the per-subtask branch, (b) if cherry-pick fails, surface the error and fail the task (conflicts = planner error, out of scope).
acceptance_criteria: Successful subtask commits are cherry-picked onto the main worktree in subtask-ID order
Cherry-pick failure throws an error with details (which file conflicted)
Cherry-pick only runs for multi-subtask groups (single-subtask groups don't need it)

subtasks.title: Cleanup per-subtask worktrees after group completes
subtasks.description: After cherry-picks complete (or all subtasks fail): (a) remove each per-subtask worktree via 'git worktree remove --force', (b) delete the per-subtask branches, (c) prune git worktree metadata. Must run in a finally block so cleanup happens regardless of success/failure.
acceptance_criteria: Per-subtask worktrees are removed after group processing (success or failure)
Cleanup runs in a finally block (guaranteed even on cherry-pick failure)
Full group failure: per-subtask worktrees are cleaned up, original error surfaced (AC8)

subtasks.title: Crash recovery: detect and remove stale per-subtask worktrees on resume
subtasks.description: At the start of runImplement (before the group loop), scan for stale per-subtask worktrees matching <worktree-base>/<task-worktree-name>-st* and remove them. Stale worktrees have no corresponding active session and their subtasks are not marked completed in plan.json.
acceptance_criteria: Stale per-subtask worktrees are detected and removed on pipeline resume (AC9)
Removal uses git worktree remove --force + branch -D + worktree prune

subtasks.title: Update existing tests for new worktree behavior
subtasks.description: Fix any failing tests in orchestrator.test.ts, orchestrator-artifacts.test.ts, orchestrator-pipeline.test.ts, and related test files that mock or assert worktree paths in the runImplement section. Tests that assert createSession receives pipeline.worktreePath must now account for per-subtask worktree paths.
acceptance_criteria: All existing orchestrator tests pass with the new worktree behavior
Tests that assert createSession cwd are updated to match per-subtask worktree paths
New test(s) verify per-subtask worktree creation for multi-subtask groups
